source.title: My predictions for some price spikes — original author's follow-up discussion of rank-2 Dawn Crystal outcomes
source.author: MrNoobyy

quote: you can expect ~2/3 crystals to be rank 2.
notes: Original author's approximate expectation for rank-2 share among Dawn Crystals from unspecified Midnight epic-gear disenchanting at the stated maxed setup, not a measured sample. The source supplies NO completed casts, itemLink/bonuses, output hit counts, stack units, zeros, original event log, or precise patch/build. Do NOT interpret 2/3 as an observed per-cast chance or convert it to an exact percentShown. Output identity 243606 is corroborated independently by https://goldcap.gg/retail/us/items/243606 (rank 2 Dawn Crystal), but the author did not include an item ID. Source post March 17, follow-up March 18; early-season, not a verified current 12.1.5 cohort.
specialization: Epic disenchanting node maxed; base disenchanting node maxed
stats: All rare-quality profession gear (the tools/accessories, NOT item being disenchanted)
